q: In HoTT, the Encode-Decode method proves a path space calculation. For the circle S¹, to prove π₁(S¹) = ℤ, one defines a 'code' Cover: S¹ → U by Cover(base) = ℤ and Cover(loop) =
opts: the successor function equiv succ: ℤ ≃ ℤ
exp: The universal cover of S¹ is the path space. In HoTT: Cover: S¹ → U with Cover(base) = ℤ and Cover(loop) = (ℤ ≃ ℤ) via succ. The encode map sends p: base = x to transport^Cover(p, 0) ∈ Cover(x). The decode map sends n ∈ ℤ to loop^n. Together they give π₁(S¹) ≅ ℤ.
